manifest.name: dsh-host-notify
manifest.description: Host-side macOS notifications for DeepSeek Harness: ask_user_question / approval / reply-finished, delivered via a vendored signed notifier app — immune to hidden-renderer notification loss. 宿主侧 macOS 系统通知：提问/审批/回复完成，经签名通知 App 投递，免疫渲染进程隐藏丢通知。

bundle.text:
# dsh-host-notify — 宿主侧系统通知插件
#
# host 半区监听 waterfall 事件（user-questions/request、approval/request），
# 经 osascript 发 macOS 系统通知。不走渲染进程/Service Worker，
# 页面隐藏、后台挂起、勿扰之外的任何状态下都能送达。
#
# Install: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-host-notify

- insert:
    - id: dsh-host-notify
      name: dsh-host-notify

readme.text:
简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

**离开 DSH 页面也不错过任何动静。** 当模型停下来需要你（提问 `ask_user_question` / 权限审批 / 方案待确认）、或一轮回复在后台跑完时，本插件用 **macOS 系统通知 + 提示音**提醒你——通知带鲸鱼图标、持续驻屏、**点击直接把 DSH 抬回前台**。

与浏览器半区通知插件的本质区别：**本插件完全运行在宿主（host）进程**，不经渲染进程、不经 Service Worker。Electron 隐藏/挂起窗口下浏览器通知会静默丢失（实测 9 发 2 中），宿主侧投递则不受页面状态影响——这是本插件存在的全部理由。

| 时机 | 标题 | 音色 |
|---|---|---|
| 提问（`ask_user_question`） | 🔔 需要你 · 提问 | Glass |
| 权限审批 / 方案待确认（plan review） | 🔔 需要你 · 审批 | Glass |
| 一轮回复完成（`agent/status` → idle） | ✅ 回复完成 | Ping |

子代理（subagent）子会话的事件默认静音（它们是主对话那一轮的步骤）；同一交互 60s 去重，同一 agent 完成事件 5s 去重。
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-host-notify

dsh plugin --profile web add github:huhui-tech/dsh-host-notify
```

桌面 App（Electron）用户：在应用内插件管理器中输入 `dsh-host-notify` 安装，然后重启应用。

**仅限 macOS**（`"os": ["darwin"]`）——其他平台安装后插件静默不启用，不影响宿主。

readme.section: 首次使用（一次性设置，约 1 分钟）
readme.text:
插件的通知由一个随包自带的微型签名应用 **DSH Notifier** 发出：

1. 第一条通知到达时，macOS 可能弹出授权框「"DSH Notifier"想给你发送通知」→ 点**允许**；
2. 打开 **系统设置 → 通知 → DSH Notifier**（鲸鱼图标），建议把通知样式设为**「持续」**——横幅将驻留屏幕直到你手动关闭，绝不会一闪而过；
3. 如需静音，把该页的声音关掉即可（或等待后续版本加设置项）。

万一 DSH Notifier 失效（极少见），插件自动降级为 `osascript` 投递（署名为「脚本编辑器」，可靠性相同，仅无图标与点击唤醒）。

```
ask_user_question / approval / 回复完成（host waterfall/status 事件）
  → dsh-host-notify 监听（global 全会话、透传不断链、按键去重）
  → vendor/DSH Notifier.app（内嵌 terminal-notifier 二进制，独立签名）
  → macOS 通知中心（图标 + 声音 + 持续 + 点击 -activate 抬窗）

关键设计：

- **waterfall 监听严格透传**：`user-questions/request`、`approval/request` 均为 waterfall 事件，监听器只产生副作用，必须 `next()` 原样交还——本插件绝不可能阻断提问/审批链；全部异常静默吞掉，通知是增益不是依赖。
- **注入安全**：投递命令与参数全部以数组形式传给 `spawn`，无任何 shell 拼接；标题/正文长度截断 80 字。
- **会话标签**：通知正文优先带官方 `sessionTitle` 服务的会话标题（你认得是哪条会话），缺失时回落模型名。
- **去重**：交互级 60s、完成级 5s，HMR/重载不重复打扰。

- [chromoany/dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me)（MIT）：产品灵感来源。它是浏览器半区实现，功能更丰富（设置页、可操作按钮、子代理细化）；在 Electron 桌面端受渲染层限制时通知可能静默丢失——本插件是为了根治这一层而生的极简宿主侧方案。
- [bitterSmilezzz/dsh-notify](https://github.com/bitterSmilezzz/dsh-notify)（MIT）：同样走宿主层系统通知（terminal-notifier/osascript），事件覆盖与呈现策略不同。
- 随包 `vendor/DSH Notifier.app` 内嵌 [julienXX/terminal-notifier](https://github.com/julienXX/terminal-notifier) 二进制（MIT），见其许可证（本仓库 NOTICE）。
MIT（插件本体）· 内嵌组件许可证见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

[简体中文](README.md) | English

**Never miss your agent again when you leave the DSH page.** When the model stops and needs you (`ask_user_question` / permission approval / plan review), or a reply finishes in the background, this plugin pings you with a **macOS system notification + sound** — whale icon, persistent banner, and **clicking it raises DeepSeek Harness back to the front**.

What makes it different from browser-half notification plugins: **it runs entirely in the host process** — no renderer, no Service Worker. On Electron desktops, browser notifications posted from hidden/throttled windows get silently dropped (measured: 2 of 9 delivered). Host-side delivery doesn't care about page state at all. That is the entire reason this plugin exists.

| Event | Title | Sound |
|---|---|---|
| Question (`ask_user_question`) | 🔔 Action needed · Question | Glass |
| Approval / plan review | 🔔 Action needed · Approval | Glass |
| Reply finished (`agent/status` → idle) | ✅ Reply finished | Ping |

Subagent events are muted (they are steps of the parent turn). Per-interaction 60s dedup; per-agent 5s dedup for completions.
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-host-notify

dsh plugin --profile web add github:huhui-tech/dsh-host-notify
```

Desktop (Electron) app: type `dsh-host-notify` into the in-app plugin manager, then restart the app.

**macOS only** (`"os": ["darwin"]`) — on other platforms the plugin loads as a silent no-op.
If DSH Notifier ever fails (rare), the plugin automatically falls back to `osascript` delivery (credited to "Script Editor" — equally reliable, just no icon or click-to-raise).

```
ask_user_question / approval / reply finished (host waterfall/status events)
  → dsh-host-notify listener (global, pass-through, key-deduped)
  → vendor/DSH Notifier.app (vendored terminal-notifier binary, adhoc-signed)
  → macOS Notification Center (icon + sound + persistent + click-to-raise)

Design notes:

- **Waterfall listeners always pass through**: `user-questions/request` and `approval/request` are waterfall events — listeners only produce side effects and must `next()` the payload untouched. This plugin can never block a question or approval chain; every failure is swallowed silently. Notifications are a bonus, never a dependency.
- **Injection safety**: all delivery args go to `spawn` as an array — zero shell interpolation; title/body clipped to 80 chars.
- **Session labels**: bodies prefer the official `sessionTitle` service's title (you recognize the conversation), falling back to the model name.
- **Dedup**: 60s per interaction, 5s per agent completion — no HMR/reload double-firing.

- [chromoany/dsh-notify-me](https://github.com/chromoany/dsh-notify-me) (MIT): product inspiration. Browser-half implementation, richer features (settings UI, actionable buttons); may silently lose notifications from hidden renderer windows on Electron desktops — this plugin is the minimal host-side answer to exactly that layer.
- [bitterSmilezzz/dsh-notify](https://github.com/bitterSmilezzz/dsh-notify) (MIT): also host-side system notifications, with different event coverage and presentation.
- The vendored `vendor/DSH Notifier.app` embeds the [julienXX/terminal-notifier](https://github.com/julienXX/terminal-notifier) binary (MIT) — see [NOTICE](NOTICE).
MIT (the plugin itself) · vendored component licenses in [NOTICE](NOTICE).
